source_fit_rows.source_population: 34-year-old woman referred by her general practitioner to ENT for intermittent left-ear muffled hearing, later diagnosed with vertebral artery dissection / Bow Hunter's syndrome (case report)
source_fit_rows.family_population: 71-year-old adult with unilateral left-ear plugging and muffled hearing 5 days after cotton-swab use
source_fit_rows.note: Source describes a younger (34-year-old) primary-care patient referred to ENT for unilateral left-ear 'muffled hearing' (subsequently found to have vascular pathology), adapted here to a 71-year-old adult with unilateral left-ear muffled hearing after cotton-swab earwax impaction.
